about_paragraphs: I study computer science and physics at Cal State Long Beach, with a minor in biology. I'm a BUILD Scholar working toward MD/PhD training.
My collaborative research experience spans gait and rehabilitation, behavioral neurobiology, protein molecular dynamics, and surgical ergonomics.
I'm interested in measurement, reproducible analysis, and scientific software. Alongside research, I make interactive tools, games, and the fiction world Spire of Octaves.
Research contributions are collaborative; synthetic demos are not evidence of clinical validity, learning gains, or real-world savings. Public projects include their own scope and limits.
